reviews.review_description: I really like your content and would like the opportunity to be a successful moderator in your game. I have a channel on my own, TheNoobiestProVR, and it is going well. I feel I would be good at the job because I know what levels of punishment is going to be most effective. Like if someone is swearing, I will warn them. If they don’t listen, I’ll show them a mod item and warn them again, if not I will kick them and report them to you. Thanks for the opportunity, and bye bye!
